features.title: Modern Banking Infrastructure for the Americas
features.subtitle: Built to power real multi-currency business and individual payments across North and South America.
features.f1Desc: Select from 14 official currencies of the Americas & Europe: USD, CAD, MXN, BRL, ARS, CLP, COP, PEN, and EUR. Your account is ready instantly with a guaranteed 0.00 starting balance.
features.f2Desc: Search contacts by name, email, phone, or unique @novatag. Real-time debit from the sender and credit to the recipient applied simultaneously in the double-entry ledger.
features.f3Desc: Every cent that leaves an account is strictly balanced and audited against a counterparty wallet. Mathematical precision with zero phantom balances.
features.f4Desc: Your profile displays verified information (name, email, phone, country, language, novatag). Easily manage your security credentials from your private portal.
features.f5Desc: Interface natively available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and French to serve financial flows across the entire American continent.
features.f6Desc: Download official encrypted proof of transfer receipts for accounting, tax compliance, or vendor verification in one click.

about.title: The Financial Bridge for the Americas
about.subtitle: Trust Link Bank connects the financial markets of North, Central, and South America with real multi-currency accounts, instant settlement rails, and bank-grade ledger compliance.
about.pillar1Desc: Strict KYC verification without friction ensures only authentic people and businesses send and receive funds.
about.pillar2Desc: Derived balances from immutable ledger entries. Every transfer is balanced and reconciled in real-time.
about.pillar3Desc: Seamless connectivity with Fedwire, NACHA, Pix, SPEI, Interac, and SEPA to bridge domestic and international rails.

security.title: Institutional-Grade Banking Protection
security.subtitle: Your deposits, personal data, and transfer flows are secured by multi-layer encryption and rigorous global compliance.
security.sec1Desc: All data in transit and at rest is secured using AES-256 and TLS 1.3 cryptographic protocols.
security.sec2Desc: Automated anomaly detection scans all transfers for suspicious patterns, preventing unauthorized access.
security.sec3Desc: Every transaction requires unique idempotency tokens, completely eliminating accidental double debits.
security.sec4Desc: Customer funds are held in segregated partner custodial accounts at Tier 1 institutions.
security.auditNotice: Certified SOC2 Type II & ISO 27001 Security Controls
